sentences.text: No. NOTE 3. 09.05.2025 Dr.VJP,J  I.A.No.2 of 2024  The present interlocutory application is filed  seeking suspension of sentence of imprisonment  imposed against the petitioner/accused in Sessions  Case No.19 of 2023 on the file of learned VIII  Additional District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special  Judge for trial of offences against Women, East  Godavari District at Rajamahendravaram, and to  enlarge the petitioner on bail, pending disposal of  the Criminal Appeal.
Heard Sri V.R.Machavaram, learned counsel for  the petitioner and Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned  Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for the  respondent.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner was convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 342 and 506 of IPC.

The petitioner/ accused was sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment for a period of seven years and to pay a fine of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand only) for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC, in default of payment of fine, he shall undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two years and further he was sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of one year each for the offences punishable under Sections 342 and 506 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner further would submit that the petitioner has good grounds to succeed the appeal and the appeal may take some considerable time for disposal.
Learned counsel finally prays to allow the petition by imposing certain conditions to ensure the presence of the petitioner before this Court in the present Appeal.
Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that this Court may impose appropriate conditions while considering the petition.

Considering the submissions made, this petition is allowed on the following conditions:
